verdict.rationale: MoQ Relay connects arbitrary publishers to subscribers. A production report shows independent programmatic subscribers (an archiver, live transcription, voice ID) attaching to one published broadcast, with new consumers requiring no publisher migration. Explicit per-track subscription is only implied by the track model, and late attach lost initial audio until the team changed the subscription and credential ordering. missing for 10: explicit documentation of subscribing to a single track within a broadcast, a first-party agent-oriented subscription example, and evidence that late-joining subscribers do not miss data without workarounds.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent subscribes to a single track of a live broadcast without the publisher changing anything about how it publishes

citations.quote: publish Opus to one relay, which fans out to independent subscribers: an S3 archiver, Zoom Scribe Live transcription, and voice ID. They say adding a new consumer no longer requires another recorder or a migration.
Dynamic announcements, connecting arbitrary publishers to subscribers.
